metadata.framework: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS)

requirements.title: Install and Maintain Network Security Controls
requirements.description: Establish and maintain a secure network infrastructure to protect cardholder data.

controls.summary: Establish firewall and router configuration standards.
Secure and synchronize router and firewall rule sets.

requirements.title: Apply Secure Configurations to All System Components
requirements.description: Apply secure configurations to hardware and software components to prevent exploitation.

controls.summary: Always change vendor-supplied defaults before installing systems.
Develop configuration standards for all system components.
